questions.text: If a disease affects 1 in 1,000 people, and you test positive for this disease with a test that is 99% accurate (1% false positive rate), what is the probability that you actually have the disease?
If you flip a fair coin 3 times, what is the probability of getting at least 2 heads?
questions.explanation: Outcomes with at least 2 heads: HHH, HHT, HTH, THH. That's 4 out of 8 possible outcomes = 0.5
